title: Tom's Happy Days
text:
Tom has a red bike. He rides it to the park every day. The park is near his house. Tom likes to play with his friends there.

On Sunday, Tom and his dad went to the lake. They ate sandwiches and drank juice. Then they swam in the water. Tom was very happy.

questions.text: What did Tom and his dad do at the lake?
options: They ate sandwiches and drank juice.

questions.text: How does Tom probably feel when he plays with his friends in the park?
Why was Tom probably happy on Sunday?
options: He spent a fun day with his dad
He had a test at school

paragraph_translations: Tom ma czerwony rower. Codziennie jeździ nim do parku. Park jest blisko jego domu. Tom lubi tam bawić się ze swoimi przyjaciółmi.
W niedzielę Tom i jego tata pojechali nad jezioro. Zjedli kanapki i wypili sok. Potem popływali w wodzie. Tom był bardzo szczęśliwy.
